rows.label: Applicant
rows.value: San Juan County Conservation Land Bank

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: The project is on property owned by the San Juan County Conservation Land Bank. Work will be focused in the northern 1/3 of the 58-acre county-owned property and will complete the process of converting the former Glenwood Inn resort to a publicly owned natural area. Work will focus primarily on removing infrastructure associated with the former resort, restoring and enhancing wetland and upland habitats and installing limited infrastructure to support low-impact recreational access. Specifically, the project will restore and enhance wetlands that were largely eliminated by the creation of a pond and the construction of the main house. Restoration grading in the location of the pond and house will increase the extent and quality of the existing delineated wetlands. The project will also remove and re-route portions of the access road and reconfigure and enlarge existing parking areas. There will be an overall reduction in impervious surfaces due to building removal and conversion of portions of the existing road to pedestrian trails.
